أغلنثي (form IIIq)
# أَغْلَنْثِي (ʔaḡlanṯī) /ʔaɣ.lan.θiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
# أَغْلَنْثِيَ (ʔaḡlanṯiya) /ʔaɣ.lan.θi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِغْلَنْثَى (iḡlanṯā)
